name: Foodaholic Sun Multi Sun Cream SPF 50+ PA+++ (70ml)
description:
Foodaholic Sun Multi Sun Cream SPF 50+ PA+++ (70ml)
Made in Korea
The cream works in several directions: protects skin from ultraviolet radiation - with a high SPF 50+ and PA++ + .Obespechivaet protection up to 12 hours of UVA and UVB rays.
Consisting of arbutin and adenosine
Refreshes, clarifies, hydrates and moisture. It does not leave greasy.
Waterproof controls perspiration
